node_experiments.scope: Isolated feasibility; no user code executed. Trusted engine bundles run in Node Workers with96MiB old-space/16MiB young-space limits and2second deadline. Limits do not apply to production browser heaps.

browser_experiments.scope: Fresh isolated HTTP browser prototype; no production pages. Parse5 allowlisted structural HTML; all attributes removed; no scripting/stylesheet/image/foreign/form/navigation support. Sandbox empty and CSP default-src none. CDP child probes are test instrumentation, never preview user scripts.
limitations: Tested Edge156 only; hosted CI will use pinned Chromium. No universal browser isolation or hard Worker heap certification.
Timers and Worker termination do not guarantee bounded prior allocation. Text/node/depth/token limits apply; no decompression supported.

decision_notes: CSSO5.0.5/css-tree2.2.1 was evaluated and rejected for unsupported modern media-range syntax; current CSS-Tree3.2.1 parsing/generation selected instead. No CSSO code adopted.

Prettier strict-whitespace output is checked against canonical HTML5 parsing; changed parsed content fails closed. Some HTML5 repair is permitted when parsed content is preserved. Embedded JS/CSS formatting disabled.
Terser compression and name mangling disabled; both Acorn and Terser must accept input. No input code executed.
HTML-to-Markdown uses a reviewed bounded parse5 tree converter. It outputs text, not rendered Markdown; unsafe link destinations omitted.

Preview: parse5 structural tag allowlist, all attributes removed, active/foreign/resource elements omitted, empty sandbox and restrictive CSP. No stylesheet, image, link-navigation, form or script support.

Generic scaffold dry-run refuses PLANNED entries. Owner explicitly authorized these six IDs; specialized pages follow existing adapter/fixture/integration conventions without weakening generator safety or temporarily changing registry statuses.
limitations: Feasibility browser: Edge156. Production-page scoped tests passed separately; full mapped local and mandatory hosted pinned Chromium results are recorded in development evidence / exact PR checks.
Timers/Worker termination are safeguards, not hard heap guarantees. Small text, node, token, depth and output caps reduce bounded workload; no decompression supported.
Native OS clipboard/download dialogs, screen readers, physical devices and cross-engine certification excluded.
Current libraries may contain undisclosed bugs. OSV absence is not a universal security clearance.
PDF tools remain deferred; GA4 property-level reporting unverified.
asset_hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8/LF bytes including final newline; Windows checkout CRLF normalized.

dependency_delivery_scope.production: Four prebundled Worker-source strings; no runtime package installation/backend/QR or processing service. Parent loads only the existing styling CDN and unchanged shared consent component.
dependency_delivery_scope.unused_or_tree_shaken: CLI and source-map dependency metadata still reviewed and notices retained. No source-map output enabled.
